notes.title: Attention!
notes.notes:
Due to the fact that GoGobundle deleted their mail and did not make contact for a long time, we decided to revoke the keys that were given to them for sale. But so that the players would not suffer from our mistake, we decided to return the key to anyone who withdraws it.
Until March 20, 2019, you must leave any feedback on the game, no matter positive or negative.
March 21, we will begin to recall the keys. If your key was revoked, then you need to write about this in the recall, then we will send you a new key, which will never be revoked.
